service: Public expenditure execution in programme-budget mode (engagement, liquidation, ordonnancement, management dialogue)
title: Manuel de procédures d'exécution de la dépense publique en mode programme (dernière version)
authority: Ministère de l'Économie et des Finances, Direction Générale du Budget
locator: Part I 'Acteurs de la chaîne de la dépense'; procedure 'dialogue de gestion' Etape 1-4 (Gestionnaire de crédits -> RA -> Ordonnateur délégué -> DPAF), and later Etape 1-13 chains ending at Ministre chargé des Finances
finding: Numbered step chains assign each action to a named actor (gestionnaire de crédits/RAc, responsable de programme as ordonnateur délégué, DPAF, DGB, Directeur national du Contrôle Financier, Minister) with per-step deadlines (e.g. 'Délai: un (01) jour') and decision content of the management dialogue.
limitations: 40 MB scanned PDF with OCR noise; read via local text extraction, not every chapter checked. Internal finance workflow, not a citizen service.

service: Processing of Central Government loan guarantees, on-lending (rétrocession) and direct loans
title: Manuel de procédure du traitement des opérations de garanties sur emprunts, de rétrocessions et de prêts directs du Gouvernement Central
authority: Ministère de l'Économie et des Finances, Direction Générale du Trésor, Direction de la Dette Publique
locator: Partie 1 Intervenants (1.1-1.4); Partie 2 section 2.6 'Quelles sont les étapes pour octroyer une garantie sur emprunt', Etape 1-3; sections 3.6 and 4.6 for on-lending and direct loans
finding: Step sequence: Etape 1 saisine of the Minister by the requesting entity (SOE/EP/CTD), Etape 2 transmission to the Direction de la Dette Publique which verifies the file against a required-documents table and corresponds with the applicant, Etape 3 examination by CARC members with the DDP acting as CARC/CoTD secretariat; roles and responsibilities of Minister, CoTD, CARC and DDP are defined.
limitations: Internal Treasury workflow serving public entities, not a citizen-facing service; two-column PDF layout read via local extraction.

service: Towing, payment and release of road-obstruction/abandoned vehicles by FRSC field commands
title: Standard Operating Procedure for Towing, Payment and Release of Road Obstruction/Abandoned Vehicles by Field Commands
authority: Federal Road Safety Corps (FRSC)
locator: para 7 'Procedure for towing' (a-d); para 9 'Towing of vehicles on request' (a-f); para 12 release procedure; para 17 command responsibilities
finding: Team leader photographs the obstruction, obtains Commanding Officer/Head of Operations approval by phone/SMS, tows to an approved park and issues a Notice of Offence (held in Duty Room if driver absent); on-request towing requires the Command to verify police report and ownership, generate a Remita RRR payment before towing, issue a form and open a case file.
limitations: Short 8-page SOP (one function); 2019 edition. Port Process Manual (shipperscouncil.gov.ng) downloaded but is image-only and unreadable.

service: Granting of an authorisation to operate a mobile virtual network (MVNO)
title: Manuel de procédures pour l'octroi d'une autorisation d'exercice de l'activité d'opérateur d'un réseau virtuel des télécommunications
authority: Ministère des Technologies de la Communication
locator: rows 'Traitement des dossiers', 'Suites des demandes', 'Délais de réponse', 'Procédures de délivrance', 'Phase de l'accord de principe', 'Phase intermédiaire' (3-page bilingual table)
finding: Secrétariat permanent checks completeness and submits the file to the Commission consultative for opinion; ministry services notify one of three outcomes (approval with convocation, request to rectify omissions, reasoned refusal) within one month; decision delivered against receipt of a 50,000 DT Treasury deposit with a three-copy delivery PV signed by the secretariat officer, with a copy to the Bureau d'Ordre Central.
limitations: Only three pages; phases and actors are stated but no detailed internal checklists. Edition date not printed.

service: Civil-service processes of the Dirección General del Servicio Civil (ethics code compatibilisation, complaints handling, normative drafting)
title: Manual de Procesos y Procedimientos de la Dirección General del Servicio Civil (Código 001, Versión 1)
authority: Ministerio de Trabajo, Empleo y Previsión Social, Dirección General del Servicio Civil
locator: Procedure 1.1 'Compatibilización de Códigos de Ética Institucionales', pp. 5-8 task table (Nº / Tarea / Producto / Insumos / Plazo en días hábiles / Responsable) and flowchart p. 11
finding: Each procedure has an identification block (objective, legal basis, responsible unit) and a task table: e.g. UCEyDN receives and registers the request (1 day), reviews minimum content and issues observations report (5 days), UCEyDN and DGSC send a note giving the entity 10 days to correct (2 days); flowcharts follow.
limitations: Internal regulatory/HR function of the ministry rather than a citizen service; 108 pages, only the first procedures read. Lead 2 (FUNDEMPRESA commerce-registry manual) returned 404.

locator: none

service: Consular services (passports, visas, legalisations, assistance to nationals) at Paraguayan consulates
title: Manual Consular 2025
authority: Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores, Dirección General de Asuntos Consulares (Resolución N° 1049/24)
locator: Capítulo 3 Procedimientos consulares, 3.2.6 Visas (pp. 13-14); 3.2.11 expedición de documentos; Capítulo 4 asistencia; Capítulo 5 procedimientos administrativos (5.1.1, 5.2.1, 5.3.1)
finding: For non-resident visas: applicant files the electronic form, the system routes a notice to the nearest consular office, the responsible consular officer checks the data, may call an interview, records an acceptance/rejection suggestion in the SIC, prints and affixes the sticker and hologram; nationality-restricted cases require DPSC authorisation in the SIC; 74 pages covering passports, legalisations, assistance and office administration.
limitations: Mixes applicant requirements with officer steps; some sections are requirement lists rather than full workflows.

service: Online registration of limited liability companies by non-residents

finding: Nine applicant-side steps on the dth.az portal (login with Asan Imza, enter company, founder, executive body, activity data, approve generated charter); no internal tax-authority processing roles or actions.
limitations: Citizen-facing web-form guide only.

service: Cross-cutting rules for delivery of e-services by central executive bodies (administrative regulations per service)
title: Qərar № 191 'Mərkəzi icra hakimiyyəti orqanları tərəfindən konkret sahələr üzrə elektron xidmətlər göstərilməsi Qaydaları' və 'Elektron xidmət növlərinin Siyahısı'
authority: Cabinet of Ministers of the Republic of Azerbaijan

finding: Cabinet decision requiring every central executive body to draft a per-service 'inzibati reqlament' (administrative regulation) to a standard template, with a list of e-services; the MIA services page links such regulations on e-qanun.az.

One gov.ir-targeted search returned no official PDFs.

service: Electronic customs declaration and clearance at border checkpoints (ASYCUDA)
title: Instruction on Electronic Customs Declaration No. 00097/CD (unofficial translation)
authority: Ministry of Finance, Customs Department
locator: Section 10 'Step 1: Declaration of transport documents' (10.1.1-10.1.2), 'Step 2: Filling in information and documentation' (10.2), subsequent steps on assessment, payment, inspection and release
finding: Officers in charge of warehouse receive transport documents within 24 h and key them into the transport-document management system (or inventory book where not deployed); traders then lodge the detailed declaration in ASYCUDA, attach scanned supporting documents, ASYCUDA computes duties, and the instruction continues through customs officer checking and release; duties of officers and prohibitions are listed.
limitations: Unofficial English translation on the national trade portal (MOIC); 2017 edition. Mixes trader obligations and officer steps.

service: Coordination and referral pathway for women and girls subject to violence
title: Standard Operating Procedures for Coordination, Governance of Coordination and Referral Pathways for Women and Girls Subject to Violence
authority: National Commission for the Advancement of Women, Mothers and Children (NCAWMC), with UNFPA support
locator: Part 3 coordination bodies and secretariat; Part 4.1 'Help-Seeking and Referral Pathway' and Figure 3 (p. 17)
finding: Defines a steering committee and secretariat, and a referral sequence (receive disclosure, crisis intervention, referral to police, health, Lao Women's Union or social services based on survivor consent) applicable to all sectors.
limitations: Multi-sector coordination SOP with UN support; sector-specific internal steps not verified in depth (15 MB file read only in part).

service: Preparation of pension papers and sanction of pension for retiring federal government servants
title: A Manual of Pension Procedures (revised edition 2006)
authority: Establishment Division, Pakistan Public Administration Research Centre (with Finance Division and AGPR)
locator: Sl. No. 53 'Procedure for preparation of pension papers and sanction of pension' (pp. 74-76), items (i)-(v) and following; Sl. No. 87 overpayment disposal (p. 119); service-record measures (p. 61)
finding: Heads of Departments/Offices start pension papers one year before retirement, fill Part II sections 2-5 of Form CSR 25, check for recoveries and pending disciplinary action, obtain Part I plus specimen signatures/photos six months before retirement, then forward to the Audit Office which verifies service and issues the PPO; Accounts Officers and Chief Accounts Officer (Foreign Affairs) steps for overseas payment are specified.
limitations: 2006 edition hosted by AGPR; compiles office memoranda rather than a single flowchart; internal HR/finance function.

locator: User guide sections on registration by role, services and dashboard request tracking
finding: Explains how trainees, trainers, centres and project owners register and track requests; only says applications are 'reviewed by the Commission' with statuses (under review, incomplete, accepted/rejected).

service: Processing of cadastral service requests in the electronic cadastral register (ASHK)
title: Udhëzim Nr. 682, datë 30.5.2025, 'Për miratimin e modelit të kërkesës për shërbime kadastrale dhe procedurat standarde të veprimeve me regjistrin elektronik të kërkesave'
authority: Agjencia Shtetërore e Kadastrës (ASHK) / responsible minister
locator: Chapter II 'Procedura standarde në sistemin elektronik të regjistrit kadastral, për trajtimin e kërkesës për shërbim', points 1-6 and following points on director monitoring
finding: After automatic registration of an e-Albania request, the ASHK local directorate/office sends the invoice via the system, or an authorised employee computes transfer tax confirmed by the finance officer within 2 working days; an employee confirms payment within 24 h of bank notice; unpaid requests after 30 days are auto-closed; protocol-archive sector handles paper documentation; the directorate director tracks each user's processing and the 21-day legal deadline.
limitations: Issued as a ministerial instruction (regulatory form) with an 8-page procedure; detailed per-service checks not included.
